description: Put the business's name on its outgoing calls, filed with its own carrier. product "cnam": the caller name (displayName, up to 15 characters) for numbers; on Twilio filed under the approved Business Profile (US long codes, public beta), on Telnyx set on each number at once. "voice_integrity" (Twilio): spam-label monitoring (useCase, employeeCount, dailyCallVolume). "branded_calling": on Telnyx name + logo + call reasons for Telnyx's vetting (displayName, callReasons, authorizerName, authorizerEmail, logoUrl a 256x256 BMP; enterpriseId or the enterprise details), then numbers once verified (displayIdentityId, numbers, loaUrl a signed Letter of Authorization); on Twilio registration itself is in the Twilio Console (its API is private beta), and this assigns numbers to the approved registration. Without confirm:true nothing is filed and the answer says exactly what would be. The carrier bills its fees. Free in Hermoso. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).

email.description: Twilio: where it sends notices (default the Business Profile's)

enterprise.description: Telnyx: the business details in Telnyx's own field names, when the account has no enterprise yet

trustProductId.description: Twilio: an existing product to assign numbers to

name: register_branded_calling
